name: single straight leg stretch
description: A pilates exercise where you scissor your straight legs while holding the raised one. It trains the abs and tests hamstring flexibility.
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.
